pages.text: The drowned captain of the frozen seas, called back from the deep to sail under your banner.$(br2)Summoned with a $(l:rituals/deep_ritual)Deep Ritual$(): the Frozen Key on the altar, and a full set of Salvager armor on the pedestals.$(br2)$(italic)Requires Aquamirae.$()

pages.title: As a Servant
pages.text: She fights as she always has, hooking foes in, then swinging and thrusting, growing enraged as the fight wears on. She picks her weapon for each foe: the Remnant Saber when badly hurt, her own blade when it can finish the foe quickly, the Shatterblade against hulking brutes.$(br2)Once each fight, she stands her ground and heals.
When she falls, she leaves her soul behind. On a Dark Altar it brings her back for 500 souls.
